message.content:
{
 "summary": "Valve FV-101 position does not follow command (rule FV-101.DISC, tag ZT-101) with position 60.3% against command 37.9% and a gap of 22.5. An unusual plant behaviour correlation alarm is also active for AIT-201B, AIT-201, and FV-101.",
 "likely_causes": [
  "Loss of instrument air to the actuator, or a failed positioner.",
  "Fibre and lint jamming the valve trim, or a seized stem.",
  "Position transmitter fault (the valve moves but ZT-101 does not)."
 ],
 "checks": [
  "Check the instrument air pressure at the actuator and the positioner output.",
  "Look at the valve stem and position indicator locally and compare them with ZT-101 on the HMI.",
  "Check whether the forward flow FIT-102 changes when the command changes.",
  "Compare the influent flow FIT-101 with the forward flow FIT-102.",
  "Check the level locally on the tank gauge."
 ],
 "handover": "Valve FV-101 position does not follow command with ZT-101 at 60.3% and command at 37.9% (gap 22.5), raising a discrepancy alarm at 10:02 and a correlation alarm at 10:07. Verify instrument air pressure and check the valve stem and position indicator locally against HMI tag ZT-101.",
 "citations": [
  "SOP-07 7.2",
  "SOP-07 7.3",
  "SOP-07 7.4",
  "SOP-11 11.3",
  "SOP-11 11.4"
 ]
}
